_comment: DATA for rosettaGuardedModelCall.js, shared by rosetta/interpret and the search describer. A call that failed in a way the vendor may still have billed (a timeout, a dropped connection, a 5xx) is ledgered at its worst-case estimate under the caller's unanswered recipe, so the daily ceiling counts it. A 4xx is the vendor refusing the request, which it does not bill; this pattern names it.
